thread:
maria (docs): Opening a small PR to clarify the 'Usage tiers' wording, add a migration note for renamed Grafana panels, and include a short Python SDK example for parsing rate headers. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1298

alex (product): Nice. Can we also call out the pricing delta for tier transitions? A one-line note under 'How tiers apply' should be enough.

cynthia (analytics): Please include the derived "effective_tier" metric we surface in the dashboards. Also record the new panel id: panel.usage.tiers.v3 so saved links can be updated.

leo (sdk): I'll provide the Python fallback snippet to read both headers. Team prefers tiny, copy-paste examples for quick adoption.

maria (docs): Proposed migration blurb:

"If you see missing panels after the rename: search dashboards for panel.usage.tiers.v3 and replace legacy panel ids. Saved alerts bound to old panels will need reattachment. Reach out to analytics for bulk updates."

leo (sdk): Python snippet (requests):

```py
# read rate headers with backward compatibility
limit = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Rate') or resp.headers.get('X-Rate-Limit')
burst = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Burst') or resp.headers.get('X-Burst-Credits', '0')
print(f"limit={limit}, burst={burst}")
```

cynthia (analytics): Note: the 'burst' value is a cumulative credit counter, not instantaneous QPS. We'll add a short tooltip on the dashboard explaining that transitions between tiers can briefly reflect credits.

alex (product): For the pricing note: "When a usage spike moves you into the next tier mid-billing-window, the pricing delta is prorated for the time spent in the higher tier." Keep it simple.

maria (docs): I'll add a compact compatibility table in the PR: old panel id -> new panel.usage.tiers.v3, old header -> X-RW-Rate, and whether Hosted/Dedicated requires action.

deploy-bot: docs CI: lint OK, linkcheck running.

leo (sdk): Quick ask: can docs include a short link to the SDK compatibility guide? saves people a hop.

maria (docs): Yep, will add link + anchor to SDK compatibility section. Targeting merge once linkcheck passes, ETA tomorrow morning. @cynthia @leo please ack if fine for merge after CI passes.
